name: Quantum Nonlinear Optics
description: Introduction to basic nonlinear optical processes and classical definition of electric susceptibility; nonlinear optics at surfaces/interfaces and sub-wavelength architectures; quantum mechanical description of linear, second-order and third-order susceptibilities; classical wave equations in nonlinear optical medium and dynamical evolution of beams; equations of motion under slowly varying approximation; nonlinear refractive index, nonlinear absorption and their atomic/molecular origin; nonlinear optical processes in two-level atomic systems and optical Bloch equations.
